notes: Corpus manifest for the 30-article wave-consensus corpus. source.role is 'original' for verbatim articles (the article IS that source) and 'anchor' for drafted articles (the article used to fact-check the draft). in_passing_mentions are the secondary facts deliberately included in each article, with question seeds useful for Phase 1 task 4. disputed records where the article pins one figure of a DISPUTED fact from the fact-check pass; the conflicting figure is pool CONTRADICT material. label_counts filled in P1-6 (corpus/labels); split_role and sha256 filled at Phase 2 (frozen 2026-08-26, tag prereg-waveconsensus-v1).

jury.rule: Five base models from five distinct organizations, each below 4B (1-2B preferred), documented training cutoff before 2026-08-14. Where documentation is absent, the frozen probe set (cutoff-probe/probes.md) is the eligibility gate: the model must be blind to the 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-25 window.

jury.fallback_rule: Primary below 75% on the calibration set is replaced by its same-family 4B-class sibling above; families without a 4B-class sibling (Phi, OLMoE, Qwen) take a registered cross-family fill from the 4B-class candidates.
